description: Drugs labeled for a condition (FDA) — Which drugs are FDA-labeled to treat a condition? Searches the Indications and Usage section of every openFDA drug label and returns active ingredients ranked by number of labels, with brands, Rx/OTC type, routes, pharmacologic class, latest label date and the matching indication excerpt. condition= disease or use, optional type=rx|otc|all and limit= (1-40). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: fda_indication_search
